sources.title: SciPy · Mann–Whitney U rank test
sources.locator: Definition/Notes: independent samples, equal-distribution null, complementary U statistics and rank-sum relation. Location/median interpretations need additional assumptions. Tied small samples call for permutation methods; this original construction enumerates all 20 labeled three-versus-three allocations with fixed pooled midranks.

covariance-matrix.label: Total sample coordinate variance
covariance-matrix.description: Center five paired positioning errors, place the two sample variances on a matrix diagonal and their sample covariance in both off-diagonal cells. The trace adds the two variances; the eigenvalues determine the squared radii of a descriptive covariance ellipse.

wilcoxon-signed-rank.label: Two-sided signed-rank tail probability
wilcoxon-signed-rank.description: Keep each packing comparison paired, omit exact zero differences, rank the remaining absolute differences and average ranks at ties. Add ranks by sign, then compare the absolute signed score with every fair-sign assignment of those same ranks.

mann-whitney.label: Two-sided rank-allocation tail probability
mann-whitney.description: Pool six learner scores, average the data ranks at ties, and sum group A’s ranks. Subtract six to obtain U_A, which also counts A-over-B wins with half a win for each tie. Compare it with all 20 labeled three-versus-three allocations under the exchangeable-label null.
